evidence.type: Independent source-derived mathematical expectations; not Blender/GPU validation
evidence.review: Six primary analytical cases independently recomputed by an independent reviewer. Synthetic colors isolate formulas; they do not claim Ni appearance.

coordinate_contract.source: Y-up; source vector H computations use identity view for convenience. Simultaneously rotating N/V/L to camera coordinates preserves ordinary dot products. Face uses world XZ projection.
coordinate_contract.blender_transform: C(x,y,z)=(x,-z,y); source world XZ plane becomes Blender world XY.
coordinate_contract.blender_camera: For fixture plane use normal_world and view_direction_world from each case; compare full-coverage flat interior, not silhouettes. Source identity-view bookkeeping is not a required Blender camera orientation.

fixture_rules: Use float32 linear/data images or direct float32 constants. Do not write these fixture values through PNG/JPEG, sRGB encoding, or half-float image storage before shading.

Main is deliberately linear/data for this fixture. The raw material shadow colors are source-inverse-sRGB encoded so character_material.C recovers the stated linear colors; do not decode them a second time.
Mask alpha must remain an independent channel; use CHANNEL_PACKED/Non-Color. A=.8/.7 is direction data, not material coverage. Main alpha is1.
Face texture is 2x1, sampled LINEAR at u=.25/.75 and v=.5, exact texel centers; no horizontal interpolation is intended. With height1, vertical-origin conventions do not affect the fixture.
Set UVMap constant at (.25,.5) in sampled region or sample only central pixel with that UV. If UV varies, expected H/band vary with bilinear mask filtering.
Output raw linear float32 EXR or direct node/AOV values; do not compare displayed screenshot, PNG, postprocessed RGB, or tonemapped results against finalRGB.
Use emission formula output strength1, geometry facing camera, full coverage, no unrelated occluders or shadow maps. Coverage expected1, BloomWeight0.

AOV names for current graph: HalfLambert scalar, ShadowBand color, plus rendered linear RGB. firstWeight/secondAllowed are analytical intermediate expectations if additional diagnostic taps are added by main.

precision.reference: expected_float64 is high precision algebra; expected_float32 emulates scalar/texture-value float32 arithmetic but is not a bit-exact GPU promise.
precision.comparison: Compare central full-coverage pixels or uniform ROI mean. H/band/finalRGB must all agree; a finalRGB match alone cannot verify mirror direction.
precision.boundary_note: At first-band endpoints float32 operation ordering can produce weights within ~1e-6 of0/1; tolerate stated error, but not wrong direction or width. Inputs stored as half/8bit are different cases and require recomputed expectations.
